# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hi, I’m Sofia Hernandez. I was calling because I wanted to cancel the grill order if possible.

I’m in Seattle, WA 98193, but I honestly don’t remember what email I used on the order.

And actually… if you’re about to cancel it, I’m second-guessing myself. My brother said he still wants it for a get-together next weekend, so maybe I should keep it after all.

Also, while I have you, I think I placed another order with two t-shirts and I can’t remember which ones they were. Could you tell me which two shirts I ordered and what materials they’re made of?

I can help, but first I need to verify your account.

Please provide either:
- the email used on the account, or
- your full name and ZIP code exactly as listed on the account

You’ve given me Sofia Hernandez and 98193, which may be enough if that matches the account. Please confirm:
- First name: Sofia
- Last name: Hernandez
- ZIP code: 98193

Once I verify you, I can:
- check the grill order status and whether cancellation is still possible
- leave it unchanged if you decide to keep it
- look up your t-shirt order and tell you which shirts you ordered

For the materials: I can tell you the shirt items you ordered, and then I can check the product details we have available for those items.

Yes, that’s right.

First name: Sofia  
Last name: Hernandez  
ZIP code: 98193

I don’t have the email handy, sorry. I’m pretty sure the shipping address is in Seattle, if that helps.
